# Scriptly

> Scriptly is an AI acting rehearsal app for iPhone and iPad. Actors upload a script or scene, and Scriptly reads the other characters' lines aloud so they can run lines, memorize scenes, and prepare for auditions without a human reader. It also offers AI scene analysis, character analysis, and visualizations of the scene.

- Platform: iOS only (iPhone and iPad). No Android version.
- Pricing: $14.99/month subscription through the App Store, with a 7-day free trial.
- Privacy: scripts, notes, scenes, and audio are stored locally on the user's device.
- Who it's for: film, TV, and theater actors, drama students, and acting coaches, from beginners to professionals.
- Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/scriptly-ai-acting-rehearsal/id6754227999
- Contact: support@scriptlyapp.com
